ev.q: Figure is a bar graph indicating the 2021 age-adjusted rates of U.S. firearm-related homicide by race, Hispanic origin, and sex
In 2021, the age-adjusted rate of firearm-related homicide was 11.1 deaths per 100,000 standard population for males and 2.1 for females.
Males had higher rates than females across all race and Hispanic origin groups.
